integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained; finite tridiagonal diagnostics are illustrative, not a proof. Literature comparisons are documented with their access limitations.
scientific_limitations: Fixed exponent gamma>1, power coefficients j^-gamma on complex ell_2 only. Asymptotic n->infinity; no uniform endpoint, arbitrary-weight theorem, finite-n error bound, or eigenfunction limit. Direct June 2026 full-text comparison and several general Jacobi references remain a publication-priority risk. The mathematical review is not independent validation.
title: A lattice Weyl constant for power-decaying Rhaly matrices
